candidates.title: [OOM] llama-server (2xV100 tensor-parallel, GGML_CUDA_NCCL) accumulates ~93GB shmem-rss; kernel OOM-kill under numactl membind
candidates.snippet: ## Summary  `llama-server` (custom ppc64le V100 build, `GGML_CUDA_NCCL=ON`) serving a large-context MoE model with 2-GPU tensor-split on cross-socket GPUs accumulates **~93 GB of shared-memory RSS (shmem-rss)**. When the service is NUMA-pinned via `numactl --membind`, the kernel OOM-kills the process under `CONSTRAINT_MEMORY_POLICY`; systemd then restart-loops it. The shmem footprint is ~9× the anon RSS and is by far the dominant host-RAM cost of the process.  ## Environment  - llama.cpp: v100 c
